_hinweis: Ein Motiv je Beitrag (Schluessel = Slug ohne Nummer). Stil steht in stil. Das Motiv beschreibt Gegenstaende, keine Schrift. Zusammengesetzt wird beides von scripts/gen-blog-covers.mjs.
stil: Soft 3D render in a clean premium product-illustration style, the look of a high-end SaaS website illustration. Matte plastic surfaces with generously rounded corners and soft bevels. Colour palette: deep navy blue (#243B55) with a lighter slate blue for depth, amazon orange (#FF9900) as the single bright accent, white and very light cool grey. No other bright colours. Soft diffuse studio light from above, one gentle contact shadow beneath each object, no harsh highlights. Thin glowing orange connector lines where elements relate to each other. Three-quarter isometric view. Background: a seamless, very light blue-white gradient (#EDF5FB fading to white), no floor line, no horizon, no vignette. Wide landscape composition: the scene is centred and compact, filling about the middle 55 percent of the width and 70 percent of the height, with generous empty space on the left, right, top and bottom, so a crop to a wide banner keeps the whole scene. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no brand marks, no people, no faces, no hands, no screens with readable content. Crisp, calm, high detail.
